votes.motion: Approve the Work Session minutes from June 2, 2020 and June 16, 2020.
votes.description: The Council approved the official work session meeting minutes from two meetings held in June 2020.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and refer the items (2022 Distracted Driving Prevention Program Grant and 2022 Bicycle and Pedestrian Safety Program Grant) for future action.
votes.description: The Council closed the joint public hearing on two Police Department grant applications to the Utah Highway Safety Office and referred them to a future consent agenda.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 09 of 2021, amending the FY 2020-21 final budget of Salt Lake City including the employment staffing document (Budget Amendment No. 7).
votes.description: The Council adopted the seventh budget amendment for Fiscal Year 2020-21, covering items including $6 million in rental assistance, employee bonuses, police costs, encampment prevention funding, and numerous grant appropriations.

votes.motion: Approve Resolution 14 of 2021, adopting the action plan as Exhibit A and allocate the fund grant money (One-Year Action Plan for CDBG and other federal grants for FY 2021-22).
votes.description: The Council initially approved the One-Year Annual Action Plan for FY 2021-22 covering CDBG, HOME, ESG, and HOPWA funding; this motion was subsequently reconsidered due to a conflict of interest.

votes.motion: Reconsider the previous motion of approval of Resolution 14 of 2021.
votes.description: The Council voted to reconsider the prior approval of Resolution 14 of 2021 due to Council Member Johnston's conflict of interest arising from his employment with Volunteers of America.

votes.motion: Approve Resolution 14 of 2021, appropriating the funding as outlined in Exhibit A, adopt the Action Plan, and allocate the fund grant money.
votes.description: Following reconsideration, the Council re-approved the One-Year Annual Action Plan for FY 2021-22 with Council Member Johnston recused due to his conflict of interest.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 10 of 2021 to amend the Zoning Map at the property located at approximately 706 to 740 West 900 South and 710 to 739 West Genesee Avenue.
votes.description: The Council rezoned properties from M-1 (Light Manufacturing) to R-MU (Residential Mixed Use) to allow multi-family residential development while retaining existing commercial uses.

votes.motion: Approve Resolution 10 of 2021, authorizing an election services interlocal agreement with Salt Lake County for the 2021 municipal election.
votes.description: The Council authorized an interlocal agreement with Salt Lake County to provide vote-by-mail and potentially ranked choice voting services for the 2021 municipal election.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 11 of 2021, authorizing an interlocal agreement between Salt Lake City and Salt Lake County for 700 South reconstruction corridor preservation funds.
votes.description: The Council approved an interlocal agreement to transfer Salt Lake County corridor preservation funds to the City for transportation projects related to the reconstruction of 700 South Street.

votes.motion: Approve Resolution 12 of 2021, notifying the Lieutenant Governor that Salt Lake City will participate in the instant runoff (Ranked Choice Voting) pilot program for the 2021 municipal election without a primary election.
votes.description: The Council voted to opt into the State-authorized Municipal Alternative Voting Method Pilot Program using single-winner ranked-choice voting for the 2021 municipal election, eliminating the primary election.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 11 of 2021, amending the section of the Salt Lake City Code relating to idling of vehicles ordinance penalty and exception amendments.
votes.description: The Council amended the City Code's vehicle idling restrictions to update exception language, allow citations after one warning, and retain health and safety exemptions.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 13 of 2021, authorizing the Sustainability Department's application to the Recycling Market Development Zone Program.
votes.description: The Council approved the City's application to renew participation in the State's Recycling Market Development Zone Program, which provides income tax credits to qualifying businesses using recycled materials, limited to M-1 and M-2 zoning designations.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 12 of 2021, amending the Fiscal Year 2021 Annual Compensation Plan Appendix B for appointed employees and non-represented employees.
votes.description: The Council amended the compensation plan to add six new appointed positions, modify one existing position's title and pay grade, and increase pay grades for three other existing appointed positions.

The Council approved the full consent agenda, including setting public hearing dates for the FY 2020-21 Budget Amendment No. 8 and the FY 2021-22 City Budget, and approving board appointments for the Library Board and PNUT Advisory Board.

votes.motion: As the Local Building Authority, approve the dates specified for public comment and consider approving Resolution xx of 2021 adopting the final budget for the Capital Projects Fund of the Local Building Authority of Salt Lake City, Utah for Fiscal Year 2021-22.
votes.description: Sitting as the Board of Directors of the Local Building Authority, the Council set public hearing dates of May 18 and June 1, 2021 to consider the final budget for the Local Building Authority's Capital Projects Fund for FY 2021-22.
